title: Noetherian approximation for finite-pushforward embeddings
statement:
Let $U$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $C$ a constructible torsion
abelian sheaf on $U_{\Et}$. There is an affine inverse-system $U\cong\varprojlim
U_\lambda$ with Noetherian quasi-compact quasi-separated $U_\lambda$ and
affine transition maps, an index $\lambda$, a constructible torsion sheaf
$C_\lambda$ on $U_\lambda$ pulling back to $C$, and a finite-pushforward
embedding of $C_\lambda$ whose pullback is an embedding of $C$.

proof.text: Choose a Noetherian approximation of U over the integers [prop-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]. Reindex its opposite filtered category by a nonempty directed partial order using [lem-weil-pbc-cofiltered-limit-directed-reindex], and transport its limit cone by initiality. Each stage is Noetherian by the existing NoetherianApproximation.isNoetherian_obj instance. Apply [new-constructible-limit-descent-general] to the constructible module sheaf to obtain a constructible sheaf at one Noetherian stage and its pullback isomorphism. For the torsion abelian-sheaf statement, first choose a common annihilator and pass to the corresponding Z/n-module sheaf, then forget its module structure.

*Step 2: the finite-pushforward embedding at the Noetherian stage.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-finite-pushforward-noetherian] to $\widetilde C_\lambda$. It gives finite morphisms $h_{\lambda,i}:V_{\lambda,i}\to U_\lambda$, finite $\mathbf Z/n$-modules $M_i$, and a monomorphism of module sheaves $\widetilde C_\lambda\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_i(h_{\lambda,i})_*\underline{M_i}$. The forgetful functor is exact and preserves finite biproducts, direct images, and constant sheaves by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful], [def-weil-additive-category], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Thus its underlying map is a monomorphism $C_\lambda\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_i(h_{\lambda,i})_*\underline{M_i}$ of abelian sheaves; each $M_i$ is a finite abelian group.

*Step 3: pull back the embedding.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-embedding-pullback] to $\nu_\lambda:U\to U_\lambda$ and the monomorphism of Step 2. The base changes $h_i:V_i=V_{\lambda,i}\times_{U_\lambda}U\to U$ remain finite and locally of finite presentation, finite direct image commutes with this base change, and inverse image is exact. We therefore obtain a monomorphism $C\cong\nu_\lambda^{-1}C_\lambda\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_i(h_i)_*\underline{M_i}$, which is the asserted finite-pushforward embedding.
